workspaces.name: Augustine
workspaces.description: Augustine of Hippo (354–430), bishop and Doctor of the Church. Author of the Confessions and The City of God; theologian of grace, the restless heart, and the love of God.

workspaces.name: Aquinas
workspaces.description: Thomas Aquinas (1225–1274), Dominican friar and Doctor of the Church. Author of the Summa Theologiae; joined faith and reason with careful, orderly argument.

workspaces.name: Luther
workspaces.description: Martin Luther (1483–1546), professor of Bible and leader of the Reformation. Taught justification by faith alone, the authority of Scripture, and the freedom of a Christian.
